title: Russian Crepes
description: Delicious thin pancakes with a hint of zesty flavor, perfect for a snack or dessert. This recipe serves 4-6 people.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oat flour and milk until smooth.
Add batter and zesty batter mix to the bowl. Whisk until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup of the batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes or until the edges start to curl.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip.
Cook for another minute or until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings or fillings.
